index: Anguilla Consumer Price Index (AXACPI), all items, March 2010 quarter = 100, Statistics Department, Government of Anguilla
note: Quarterly: each year's mean is of its four quarters, which is the Department's own calendar-year average (109.63828757279775 and 118.04847087413624). Anguilla's 2021 level is the International Comparison Program's own (ICP 2021 database, in East Caribbean dollars), which the World Bank's indicators leave out.
